description: Read what one node of the matter's graph is linked to, one hop either way. `summary` counts the node's links by `kind`, `stance` and `decision` (`summaryComplete` is false past 5000 links); `edges` is a page of them. Each edge names `from`, `to` and the `neighbour` at its far end, its `kind` (`cites`: a claim rests on a fact, with `stance` `supports`, `conflicts` or `record`; `sourced-from`: a fact comes from a document), who produced it (`producer`), its `decision` (`proposed`, `accepted`, `rejected`) and `quote`: the exact text it rests on, with the document and locator. A claim's citations are those of the grade it is read with now (a re-check replaces the run's). Filter by `edgeKind`, `stance` or `decision`; paginated with a cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

decision.description: Only edges a reviewer has `accepted` or `rejected`, or that are still `proposed`.

edgeKind.description: Only edges of this kind: `cites` (a claim rests on a fact), `sourced-from` (a fact comes from a document passage), `mentions`, `about`.

nodeId.description: The node's id, from a `lists.graph.nodes.list` result or an edge's `from`/`to`.

nodeKind.description: What the node is: `fact` (a list fact), `claim` (a claim found in a verified document) or `document`. Take it from a `lists.graph.nodes.list` result.

stance.description: Only citations with this stance: `supports`, `conflicts`, or `record` (context the verdict rests on).
